headline: Nigerian Startups Seek Investor Access as Venture Capital Rebounds to $635 Million
summary: Nigerian startups are exploring targeted ways to secure venture capital as funding into the country's technology ecosystem rebounds to $635 million, though capital remains concentrated among a small number of businesses.
why: Venture capital funding trends in Africa's largest economies provide insight into the growth and maturation of regional tech ecosystems and private equity investment flows.

impacts.name: Nigerian Tech Ecosystem
impacts.why: A rebound in venture funding inflows supports growth for early-stage technology companies.
